name: X-L Plastics Inc
old_description: X-L Plastics offers an array of sizes to accommodate our customers, as well as the capability to manufacture products to exact specifications. Our main products include a variety of packaging material, such as carton & drum liners, textile coverings, and mattress bags.
about:
X-L Plastics Inc operates from Clifton, New Jersey, where it produces polyethylene film and bags for packaging applications. The company runs its extrusion and converting operations at 220 Clifton Boulevard, serving customers across the Northeast and beyond.

The firm specializes in custom and stock packaging materials, including carton and drum liners, textile coverings, mattress bags, and Gaylord and box liners in both vented and non-vented configurations. With a workforce of 175 employees, X-L Plastics handles extrusion of polyethylene film and bags, offering custom design services where clients provide exact measurements for liners and coverings.

Its products reach the bakery, industrial, and janitorial sectors. Bakery bags are designed to preserve fresh-from-the-oven quality, while industrial and janitorial bags are built for heavy-duty use. The company also supplies liners for bulk containers and protective coverings for textiles.

X-L Plastics emphasizes environmental responsibility, stating that it encourages recycling and works to reduce waste in its operations. The ability to manufacture to exact specifications and provide a wide range of sizes is presented as a core differentiator for customers needing tailored packaging solutions.
